title: More legible model choices, plus GLM-5.3 on Fireworks
summary:
A model-selection and developer-tools day: clearer catalog limits, GLM-5.3 through Fireworks, one-command DeepSeek Harness setup, and dramatically faster usage history.

GLM-5.3 is now routed through Fireworks with its reasoning, JSON, tool-calling, streaming, cache accounting, and million-token context support intact. The catalog also now shows chat context windows and supported video durations directly in model-detail tooltips, while publishing and rollout docs make model IDs easier to name, find, and keep using compatibly.

The CLI gained `polli harness dsh on|off|status`, wiring DeepSeek Harness in as a native provider with a dedicated child key, snapshots, rollback, status checks, and clean removal. The coding-harness guide was pared down around the shared lifecycle, because setup documentation should not require its own expedition.

Generation-event delivery now sends once instead of retrying application-side after transient responses, and usage-history reads return stored rows directly rather than aggregating and deduplicating an entire window at query time. A 30-day production view with 95k rows now reads in 0.03 seconds instead of processing 11.3 million aggregated rows for 15.9 seconds.
